findings.title: Your website opens
findings.why: Customers can open your website, which is the first step to winning them.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep your hosting and address paid up.

findings.title: Your site uses a secure connection
findings.why: A secure connection shows a padlock in browsers, and customers trust it.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep it up to date.

findings.title: Your page has a title
findings.why: The title is the headline customers see on Google and in their browser tab.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep it up to date.

findings.title: Your page has a short description for Google
findings.why: This short text under your name on Google tells customers why to choose you.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep it up to date.

findings.title: Your site is set up for phones
findings.why: Most of your customers browse on phones, and your site fits their screens.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep it up to date.

findings.title: Your page has a main heading
findings.why: A clear heading tells visitors and Google what your business does at a glance.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep it up to date.

findings.title: Your page does not name its main address
findings.why: Without it, Google may treat copies of your page as separate pages and split your ranking.
findings.fix: Ask your website builder to set the main address for each page.

findings.title: Customers can see how to reach you
findings.why: A phone number or chat button helps visitors become customers.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep it up to date.

findings.title: Search engines cannot read your business details
findings.why: Google shows your hours, area and phone number more clearly when your site gives them in a form it can read.
findings.fix: Ask your website builder to add your business details in the form Google reads.

findings.title: Search engines have no list of your pages
findings.why: A list of your pages helps Google find and show all of them, not only the first one.
findings.fix: Ask your website builder to create the page list and the file that guides search engines.

findings.title: Your site opens quickly for us
findings.why: It opened quickly when we visited from our server, which keeps visitors from leaving.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix here. Keep it up to date.

findings.title: We found no social media for your business
findings.why: Customers look at Instagram or Facebook to see if a business is real.
findings.fix: Open an account on the platform your customers use, and link it from your website.

findings.title: Your website does not link to your social media
findings.why: Visitors who like what they see look for your social pages, and a link makes it easy.
findings.fix: Add your Instagram, Facebook or TikTok link in the footer of your website.

findings.title: We found no social profile to check
findings.why: Without a profile there is nothing for customers to follow.
findings.fix: Open one account and link it from your website.
